Rho signs both the Windows application executable and NSIS installer before native update publication.

## Updates

- Windows candidate construction now builds `rho-desktop.exe` without a
  bundle, signs that exact executable through SignPath, and then creates NSIS
  without recompiling or replacing the signed bytes.
- The resulting installer is submitted as a separate SignPath request before
  its final Tauri updater signature is generated.
- Hosted candidate validation silently installs the exact final package,
  verifies that the installed executable is byte-identical and carries the
  expected certificate, smoke-tests it, and proves uninstall cleanup.

## Windows trust

- This development prerelease uses the current SignPath Free Trial
  self-signed test certificate. It is not publicly trusted, does not establish
  SignPath Foundation acceptance, and Windows or SmartScreen may still warn.

## Availability

- No public native-update endpoint is enabled until the exact Draft,
  installed-app, update/recovery, acceptance, and publication gates pass.
